chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Ibrahim from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Pray in the Masjid al-Khayf, which is the Masjid of Mina. And the Masjid of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) during his time was near the minaret that is in the middle of the Masjid, and its proximity to the Qibla was about thirty cubits, and to the right and left and behind it about that much. If you are able to make your place of prayer in it, then do so, for indeed a thousand prophets prayed in it.

key_terms.مَسْجِدُ الْخَيْفِ: The specific mosque in Mina known as the Shelter Mosque
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, the site near Mecca used during Hajj

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of praying in Masjid al-Khayf in Mina according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* prescribes the Masjid al-Khayf in Mina as the preferred site for prayer during the Farewell Pilgrimage, linking it to the specific location where the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his progeny) stood near the central pillar. It underscores the site's immense spiritual weight by citing that a thousand prophets prayed there, thereby validating the practice of congregational prayer in Mina as a continuation of prophetic tradition.
